name: Super Dope Pre-roll | Party Popperz
description: Blending Cherry, Lemon, Bubblegum, and Plum for a bold, flavorful cannabis experience. This unique mix delivers a potent, sweet-tangy high, preserving each strain's cherishes qualities!
